title: Capability catalog v2
description: What the engine can do, as data (ADR 0050 D6): `engines-check --catalog --json`. Generated from the engine's registries (engines_core::catalog) and parity-tested against them, the loop schema and renders, so a tool's unit conversions and a mapping guide can't drift from the engine. Numbers are f32 in the engine. v2 (ADR 0054, schema v0.9): a param's `unit`, `range`, `safe_default` and `default` are native (Hz, s, dB, …), a route into it writes `depth_key` in its unit, and the JSON is the engine's doc writer's — a silent gain's default reads -Infinity (Python's json takes it; read it as JSON5 elsewhere).

catalog_version.description: the catalog's shape version; a consumer refuses one it doesn't know

schema_version.description: the loop-doc schema version this engine reads (contracts/loop_contract_v<version>.schema.json)

engine_build.description: the engine build (ADR 0054 P10): `<version>+g<12-hex commit>`, `.dirty` when the engine's sources differed from it, `+unknown` without git; not part of `hash`

hash.description: FNV-1a 64 (hex) of the catalog's compact JSON with `hash` and `engine_build` empty — changes iff the content does (a cache key)

params.description: Instrument params (`instruments.<id>.params.<leaf>`), keyed by leaf. Which ones a type reads is in `synth_types`.

effects.description: Bus effect types (`buses.<bus>.effects.<fx>.type`), keyed by type.

unit_maps.description: How a param's number becomes a physical quantity, keyed by map id (a param names its maps in `unit_maps`).

degrees.description: semitones above the root, degree 1 first

modulators.description: The string choices of modulators and matrix routes.

lfo_wave.description: an LFO's `wave` (anything else plays as a sine)

audio.description: false for `midi`: notes and CCs go to an external synth; nothing renders

free_form.description: `midi`: any param name holds a value (a CC source), so every name applies

params.description: the params it reads with a pitched oscillator (`wave`/`source` not filtered_noise)

variants.description: Where a noise source reads a different set: `filtered_noise` (`source: "filtered_noise"`) and `pitched_noise` (plus `pitched: true`, ADR 0046). Only the variants that differ are listed: no `pitched_noise` ⇒ same as `filtered_noise`; neither ⇒ same as `params`.

note.description: what the param lists can't say (e.g. dual reads `wave` only to choose filtered_noise)

materials.description: `modal` only: each `material`'s partials; the first `num_modes` of them ring.

decay_rel.description: ring time relative to the fundamental's T60 (unit map t60_s)

kind.description: how the drift controller treats it: continuous (drifted across `range`), categorical (flipped among `options`), int_steps (±1 steps), fixed (never moved by the controller), enum (a string the controller never touches)

range.description: the authored range in `unit`; null for strings (a gain may also be -Infinity)

safe_default.description: the Tier-2 band the controller stays inside (ADR 0011) when narrower than `range`

default.description: what the engine reads when the param is omitted, in `unit` — where a route into an omitted param starts too; proven by render. -Infinity for a silent gain (osc_b_level_db, return_gain_db); null when there's no single value (root_hz: absent ⇒ the note's pitch)

modulatable.description: a matrix `mod` route into it moves it

depth_key.description: the key a route into it writes its depth under (ADR 0054 P4); null when it isn't modulatable

depth_span.description: how much of the depth's unit (octaves for a log curve) one unit of normalized depth covers — the param's span; null when it isn't modulatable

glideable.description: a song seam glides it between blocks (else it steps, ADR 0029)

options.description: the values a string param takes

unit.description: what an authored number means (schema v0.9: native): hz, s, ms, semitones, cents, ratio, db (-Infinity = silent for a gain), normalized (a unitless 0..1) or count; null for strings

display_unit.description: the unit the editor shows (Hz, s, st, ms, ¢, ×, dB, 0..1)

unit_maps.description: keys of `unit_maps` that read this param

unitMap.description: normalized (the engine's 0..1, where drift steps and route depths add) ↔ a native unit, or a unitless param's DSP reading. x (in `from`) → y (in `to`). exp: y = lo·(hi/lo)^x, x in 0..1. log: y = ln(x/lo)/ln(hi/lo) clamped to 0..1 — an exp map's inverse, x in `from` units. linear: y = hi·x (lo = 0), x in 0..1. affine: y = lo + (hi − lo)·x, x in 0..1.

source.description: the engine function or constant it comes from

samples.description: [x, y] pairs computed by `source` — a consumer checks its own conversion against them

default.description: what an omitted key gets; null: no default (the key is required where it matters)
